entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND AT RANCHI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of the appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences under Sections 323/34, 341/34 and 376 of the I.P.C. and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for 12 years along with a fine of Rs.10,000/- for the offence under Section 376 of the I.P.C.
It has been alleged that the appellant had committed rape upon the victim.
Submission has been advanced by the learned counsel for the appellant that the victim as well as her aunt have turned hostile and the medical report does not suggest the factum of the rape, but the FSL report clearly reveals that the DNA of the appellant was found over the stained brown color panty of the victim.
Regard being had to the above, we are not inclined to grant on bail to the appellant.
The same is hereby rejected at this stage.

(Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J) (Ambuj Nath, J) Jay-Rahul/
